wgpu_mc.notice.restart_pending: Restart Minecraft to apply the marked settings
wgpu_mc.notice.restart_applied: Restart Minecraft for these settings to take effect
wgpu_mc.option.diagnostics.tooltip: Write the renderer's dumps out as files: the frame the game is showing, the textures it is showing it with, and a sprite atlas after the frame or two it takes Minecraft to compose one. The dump itself is asked for by a wgpu-dump-now file in the run directory, because a dump is about one specific frame; this is the switch that lets the ask through, and wgpu-dump-frames turns both it and the logging on. What the renderer says while it does it is the Logging switch above, so a diagnostic session is usually both.
wgpu_mc.option.logging.tooltip: Write the renderer's diagnostic log lines: each pipeline the first time it is used, the binding plan it resolves names against, each render pass with its draw count, the draw and submission counters once a second, the sprite-animation pass counter, and the reports for the uploads and uniforms the renderer verifies as it goes. Off by default, because it is a line per pipeline on top of a line per second. It is a log switch and not a dump switch: Diagnostics above is what writes the frame and texture files, so either can be on without the other. This is the wgpu-logging marker as a switch, and the wgpu_mc.diagnostics system property or WGPU_MC_DIAGNOSTICS environment variable still turns it on from outside the game.
wgpu_mc.option.binding_verbosity.tooltip: Log how every binding name was resolved against a pipeline's binding plan, and what the plan was left holding: a name that only matched through the shader shim's _wm_texshim / _wm_sampler suffix, the names a plan can be bound under when one of them is not in it, and the slots a pipeline change left empty. This is the detailed version of the warning the renderer always prints when a binding is not in the plan at all, and it is the switch to turn on when a shader reads nothing and the question is which name it was looking for. This is the wgpu-binding-log marker as a switch.
